 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   The 

 3   Senate will come to order.  

 4                I ask everyone to please rise and 

 5   recite the Pledge of Allegiance.

 6                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 7   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   In the 

 9   absence of clergy, may we bow our heads in a 

10   moment of silence.

11                (Whereupon, the assemblage 

12   respected a moment of silence.)

13                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   The 

14   reading of the Journal.

15                THE SECRETARY:   In Senate, 

16   Wednesday, January 21st, the Senate met pursuant 

17   to adjournment.  The Journal of Tuesday, 

18   January 20th, was read and approved.  On motion, 

19   Senate adjourned.

20                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   Without 

21   objection, the Journal stands approved as read.

22                Presentation of petitions.

23                Messages from the Assembly.

24                Messages from the Governor.

25                Let the record show we are in 


                                                                216

 1   receipt of the Governor's State of the State 

 2   message.  I hand it down and ask that it be 

 3   filed in the Journal.

 5                Reports of select committees.

 6                Communications and reports from 

 7   state officers.

 8                Motions and resolutions.

 9                Senator DeFrancisco.

10                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   Yes, it's 

11   nice to see a Central New Yorker presiding.

12                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   Thank 

13   you, Senator.

15   please adopt the Resolution Calendar, with the 

16   exception of Resolution 276.

18   favor of adopting the Resolution Calendar, with 

19   the exception of Resolution 276, signify by 

20   saying aye.

 1   Resolution Calendar is adopted.

 4   remain at ease, there's going to be some handups 

 5   to the chair.  But there's going to be no other 

 6   business being performed today, so the members 

 7   do not have to be here unless they would like to 

 8   wait for the handup.

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:   The 

10   Senate will stand at ease.

10   Senate stands adjourned until Monday,

12   being legislative days.

14   motion, the Senate stands adjourned until Monday,
